Hurricane Front.name: Hurricane Front
Hurricane Front.description: The user's signature move: they draw in all the air they can hold around them and release it as a level storm the width of a street. Everyone in its path takes massive force damage and is hurled far down the street, parked cars roll, and barricades, cover and smoke are torn away; afterward the air around the user hangs still and they cannot make wind until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.
